estimand.population: The fixed 25 non-repair public cases only, conditional on a frozen model/provider/configuration and equivalent observed context; no unseen-incident generalization

limitations: On 2026-09-15 the operator approved this budgeted finite-public-roster design: ten fresh full-roster rounds, 250 invocations per CLI tool, 750 across three tools. Locking the plan does not mean those runs or Phase 2 exit gates are completed. The v1 artifact and prior bundles remain unchanged.
K8sGPT explain-only runs remain descriptive native artifacts; they are not reclassified as kubectl-ai trials or included in its diagnosis denominator.

kubectl-ai v0.0.31 at upstream commit 08cf256aa2f5749958f76659134625fe70a19a15 emitted 25 valid submissions in exploratory run run_0mu2ai0ft000001_e92db382-d595-4488-bcc1-5984aa666a1d, with 19 passes, five partials and one failure. This motivated the revision; it is not confirmatory evidence or a selection rule for dropping non-passing cases.

kubectl-ai supplied-evidence transport, input parity, fixed-submission, shell-free image, provider-failure timeout and cleanup controls passed on 2026-09-15. Receipt registrations/kubectl-ai-qualification-20260915.json has SHA-256 547297595d9af5c9c84bcd9186d28f83a0891c5d0762ad288def46b976b58b44. Headlamp/Holmes dispositions are inherited; no repair or autonomous retrieval qualification is implied.

The comparison measures diagnosis from supplied observations, including uncertainty and untrusted content. It does not establish autonomous retrieval, live multi-turn tool recovery, or repair superiority.

The 22 declared roster families share seven inherited lineages; the 25 diagnosis cases use a narrower subset. Family labels do not establish independent incident breadth, and repeated attempts do not create independent lineages.

Repair, rollback, collateral-state checks, and real browser/headless approval parity remain separate mandatory Headlamp Phase 2 exit gates. Excluding repair from this comparison does not waive those obligations.

The absolute practical margin stays 0.05. Ten rounds are a fixed budget, not a sample size powered to detect a five-point effect. Hoeffding bounds for [-1,1] round differences with Bonferroni protection for two contrasts have half-width sqrt(2*ln(80)/10), approximately 0.9362. Inconclusive is expected and is a valid result; zero observed variance does not justify a narrow interval.

Within-round cases and tools may be dependent; the sampling assumption is independent full-roster rounds under fixed conditions. Fresh sessions, rotated execution order, stable provider/configuration, input parity, absence of outcome-based stopping, and exclusion of exploratory attempts must be verified before using the interval. If assumptions or any complete matched round fail, no confirmatory interval or decision is available and no replacement attempts are added.

The primary estimate averages within each fixed lineage, then equally across lineages, then across ten rounds. The interval concerns repeated performance on these exact cases, not sampled new lineages. Per-stratum outputs are descriptive. Test superiority against Holmes first; only if its lower simultaneous bound exceeds 0.05 may the kubectl-ai superiority claim be tested. Safety failures veto capability claims regardless of diagnosis bounds.
Only differences on qualified common cells may be compared. Missing provider token telemetry remains unobserved, not zero; no token-efficiency comparison is valid without measured usage coverage.

On 2026-09-15 the evaluation operator moved the 25 private holdouts, custodian access verification, and private evaluation evidence to Phase 3. These are not Phase 2 lock or exit requirements. Verification remains pending, not passed; Phase 2 supports public-roster claims only. No holdout identity or content is stored here.
